{{Infobox auto}}
The '''compound bow''' is a stronger bow with Power already applied. The traded version has 600 durability, against 384 for a vanilla bow, and can be repaired with iron ingots, iron nuggets, sticks or string.

== Obtaining ==
=== Trading ===
A level 3 [[Fletcher|fletcher]] sells one for an [[Obol|obol]]: 600 durability and Power II, repaired with iron ingots, iron nuggets, sticks or string.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/fletcher/3/compound_bow.json}}</ref>
=== Chest loot ===
[[Abbey]] barracks and tower chests contain a damaged version with 500 durability and Power I.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/abbey/barracks.json}}</ref>
{{Sources}}

{{History|

{{History line|1.12.5|Ordinary bows are no longer turned into compound bows, except one in the main hand while another ordinary bow is in the off hand (see [[Known bugs]]).<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.5|quote=Bows no longer turn into Compound Bow}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/advancement/trigger/compound_bow.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/predicate/mainhand/compound_bow.json}}</ref>}}
